_comment: Shared MV3 manifest. scripts/build.mjs merges the browser file over this one (objects merge, arrays replace), fills in the version from package.json and strips every _comment key.
name: Cross-Tab-Sync
description: Keep the same open tabs in Brave and Safari. End-to-end encrypted, through a hosted or your own server.
_comment_hosts: No install-time host access. The popup requests the backend origin at pairing time (chrome.permissions.request). Loopback http is allowed only for local development (CTS_ALLOW_INSECURE=1).
